forbidden-invocation.name: The build runs no command this repository forbids
forbidden-invocation.description: No command the build ran matched the executable and arguments this guardrail is configured to look for.

command.description: Comma separated executable names to look for. Any one of them counts. Each is matched against the file name of every token in the recorded line, so `/usr/local/bin/terraform` and `npx terraform` both count, and so does a line that only mentions it, such as `grep terraform Makefile`.

arguments.description: Comma separated arguments that make an invocation a violation. Each is matched against the tokens of the command line exactly, in its `<argument>=<value>` form, and as a glob, so `-Dskip.tests=*` matches whatever value is set. If you name none, every invocation of the command is a violation.

match.description: `any` reports an invocation carrying any one of the arguments, and `all` reports one carrying all of them.

reason.description: Why this repository forbids the invocation. It replaces the default wording as the violation's message.
